name: Brazil
standard: eMAG (Modelo de Acessibilidade em Governo Eletrônico); ABNT NBR 17225 (web) and ABNT NBR 17060 (mobile) referenced by Governo Digital

laws.cite: Lei nº 13.146/2015 (Lei Brasileira de Inclusão), art. 63
laws.summary: Websites of government bodies and of companies headquartered or represented in Brazil must be accessible per international best practice.
Federal public administration portals must be accessible.
Institutionalises eMAG and requires detailed compliance reports.

applies_to: Federal public administration sites (eMAG mandatory); LBI art. 63 extends to companies headquartered or represented in Brazil.
requires: Follow eMAG for federal e-government sites
mobile: explicit — Governo Digital references ABNT NBR 17060 for mobile apps.
procurement: eMAG publishes a guide on accessibility in web development contracting (not opened).
enforcement: Administrative oversight; LBI civil remedies. No specific penalty regime verified.
notes: The Planalto URLs follow the standard pattern and were not opened. The eMAG version (3.1) is not confirmed. Whether NBR 17225 supersedes eMAG for federal sites is not established.
